values.en: Curvature of a Circle of Radius r
values.zh-CN: 半径为 $r$ 的圆周的曲率

values.en: A circle of radius $r$ has curvature identically $1/r$. The circle may be assumed to lie in the $x$-$y$ plane and be parametrized by arc length as $\alpha(s)=(r\cos(s/r),\,r\sin(s/r),\,0)$; then $\alpha''(s)=(-\tfrac1r\cos(s/r),\,-\tfrac1r\sin(s/r),\,0)$, so $\kappa=|\alpha''(s)|\equiv 1/r$.
values.zh-CN: 半径为 $r$ 的圆周的曲率恒为 $1/r$。不妨设该圆周落在 $x$-$y$ 平面上，以弧长参数化为 $\alpha(s)=(r\cos(s/r),\,r\sin(s/r),\,0)$；则 $\alpha''(s)=(-\tfrac1r\cos(s/r),\,-\tfrac1r\sin(s/r),\,0)$，故 $\kappa=|\alpha''(s)|\equiv 1/r$。
